tags: dawn, early morning, pale blue sky, morning mist, soft light
note: Cool and pale, with one warm exception: rh adds a small amount of red to highlights so the rising sun reads, while midtones stay blue. Gamma and brightness lift together to wash the shadows out into mist instead of holding them black - dawn is the one dark-hour look that should NOT be contrasty. Deliberately the gentlest chain in the set.
